description: Evaluation corpus manifest for blint v4 engine work. No binary blobs live in git: tests/scripts/build_corpus.py materializes every entry into a local directory (default corpus-build/) from local toolchains and this machine's applications. tests/scripts/validate_funcdisc.py runs the assertions below.

c_stackstr.description: C binary whose secret string is assembled word-by-word on the stack, built unstripped and stripped for the two local architectures plus a lipo universal pair.

rust_static.description: Static-pie musl Rust binary built with rust-lld; stripped with llvm-strip. Requires rustup target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.

go_static.description: Go binaries for linux/amd64 cross-compiled from the Mac; the stripped variant has no symbol table and no .eh_frame, which makes it the function-discovery stress case.

macos-system.description: Complete system executables on this Mac (not dyld-cache stubs): /bin/ls carries 93 symbols, LC_FUNCTION_STARTS and compact unwind; /usr/lib/dyld carries thousands of functions.

macos-apps.description: Real-world app binaries discovered under /Applications and ~/Applications (Contents/MacOS/*). Count varies by machine; entries are collected dynamically up to the limit.

assertions.gate: Unwind (eh_frame) discovery must recover at least 90% of the functions the unstripped binary knows from the same unwind tables. Static musl-linked C functions legitimately ship without FDEs, so recall against the full unstripped set is reported as context (measured ~0.78 on this fixture; the remainder are musl C functions without unwind records).
Mach-O compact-unwind discovery on the stripped arm64 slice.
A stripped Go ELF has no symbols and no .eh_frame; prologue scan plus call-site promotion must still yield a working function set (was zero before v4).
The ARM64 abstract interpreter reconstructs the string built byte-by-byte on the stack.
Universal binary parses cleanly, carries the new v4 metadata blocks, and every slice (not just the auto-selected first one) is summarized with per-slice security properties and analysis counters.
Every collected real-world binary parses without aborting and reports analysis coverage.
